AI you can operationalize
Automate triage with battleground intelligence
Charlotte AI gets smarter with every threat stopped. Trained on decisions of elite analysts, Charlotte AI triages detections, filters false positives, and surfaces only what matters.
×
×
Accelerate investigations with human-agent collaboration
Charlotte AI supercharges investigations, fusing analyst expertise with autonomous reasoning in a dynamic canvas. Guide investigations in real time — inject context, set priorities, and drive sharper, faster analysis.
Build and customize agents with Charlotte AI AgentWorks
Charlotte AI AgentWorks is the first no-code platform that lets any team quickly build, test, deploy, and manage trusted security agents. Using natural language, defenders can set goals, define data, and control agent behavior — without writing code.
×
×
Orchestrate your agentic security workforce
Charlotte Agentic SOAR combines the precision of security automation with the adaptability of agentic reasoning. Building on Falcon Fusion SOAR, structured logic ensures consistency and control, while mission-ready agents think, decide and act in real time for agility when it matters most.
Deploy AI safely and with full control
Charlotte AI delivers speed without compromise, scaling agentic defense with accountability and control. With built-in controls, every answer is traceable, every action user-authorized, every decision grounded in validated data and aligned to your role.
×
